title: Young Man in Hat and Glasses at Carnival, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot of a young man wearing black horn-rimmed glasses, a buttoned coat, and a textured fedora or Tyrolean hat adorned with a feather pin. He stands outdoors at night in front of a busy fairground stall or carnival midway game where fairgoers are lined up inspecting prizes and festive pennants hanging under an awning.
